memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: independent in ADLs, works night shifts as a nurse, reports occasional fatigue.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (recall 3, clock draw normal).
falls: 0 falls in past 12 months, gait steady, TUG 10 seconds (normal).
medicines: 9 regular (metformin, glimepiride, sitagliptin, empagliflozin, clobetasol, calcipotriol, methotrexate, folic acid, methylcobalamin) – polypharmacy, review against Beers.
mood: PHQ‑2 negative, no depression.
carers: spouse (husband), supportive.
goal: "Stay healthy enough to keep working and enjoy time with my grandchildren."
